name: suspender alternate superman
description: A superman variation with the feet in suspension straps, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It trains the lower back and core.
instructions: Place your feet in the suspension straps and get into a plank face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while keeping your body steady.
Return it, then lift the other arm.
Move slowly and avoid sagging your lower back.
Alternate sides for the full set.
